title: Enforce sorted __all__ (test or rule)
description: Review follow-up: ruff RUF022 enforces its own __all__ order but it is not human-alphabetical and is easy to drift as entities are added. Consider a one-line test or rule to keep package __all__ consistent. Not blocking VN.

title: Honor Retry-After on transient 5xx (502/503), not just 429
description: Code-review finding (enhancement). RetryPolicy.next only applies a Retry-After delay when status==429 (core.py:115); for retryable 502/503 it falls back to exponential backoff even when the server sent Retry-After. Current behavior is compliant with the archived request-retry spec (which scopes Retry-After to 429), so this is a future enhancement: consider applying retry_after whenever present for any retryable status, and update the spec accordingly. Found during /code-review of foundation-transport-core.

title: Apply pre-commit hygiene to CLAUDE.md + .claude/settings.json
description: pre-commit (end-of-file-fixer / trailing-whitespace / pretty-format-json) flags trailing whitespace in CLAUDE.md and a missing final newline in .claude/settings.json. These are agent-config files the agent is not permitted to commit, so make check / CI will report them until fixed by a human. Fix: run 'uv run pre-commit run -a' and commit the two files. Pre-existing scaffold condition; not part of the Foundation epic.

value: In this repo's git worktrees: (1) pre-commit hooks are NOT installed (only 'uv sync' is run, not 'make install'), so implementers must run 'uv run ruff format' AND 'uv run ruff check --fix' manually and re-stage before committing, or make check fails later. (2) The beads Dolt DB and issues.jsonl export live in the MAIN checkout's .beads/, not the worktree — bd commands work from the worktree but export to the main path; the worktree's committed issues.jsonl can be stale. (3) The agent is blocked from committing CLAUDE.md and .claude/settings.json (self-modification guard), so pre-commit hygiene on those files must be done by a human.
